name: nourish-board
description: A family nutrition platform built with Next.js and NestJS

scripts.build: npm run build -w @nourish/api && npm run build -w @nourish/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @nourish/api && node --test test/nutrition.test.js test/lookup.test.js test/migration.test.js apps/api/dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @nourish/api && npm run typecheck -w @nourish/web
